name: state-space-atlas
description: Enumerates every reachable state of small puzzles (Towers of Hanoi, sliding tiles, Klotski, Rush Hour) in a Web Worker, draws the whole state graph on a canvas, animates BFS, DFS, IDDFS, greedy and A* over it, and checks student-written heuristics for admissibility and consistency against true distances. Entirely client-side.
